Screen Recorder · Beta

Screen Recorder

Record your screen, webcam or microphone. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Screen Recorder has these main features: Screen, window, tab, webcam, microphone, or screen with webcam in a corner; Countdown, pause and resume, and a live timer. It opens video/webm, video/mp4, audio/webm.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Screen Recorder

  • Record your screen with your webcam in a corner
  • Record your screen with sound
  • A Loom alternative that keeps the video on your computer
  • Record a video from your webcam
